title: Checks for the absence of trailing commas.
summary: The presence of a trailing comma can reduce diff size when parameters or elements are added or removed from function calls, function definitions, literals, etc. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-commas and made it stable in v0.0.223.

title: Checks for the presence of trailing commas on bare (i.e., unparenthesized) tuples.
summary: The presence of a misplaced comma will cause Python to interpret the value as a tuple, which can lead to unexpected behaviour. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-commas and made it stable in v0.0.223.
message_templates: Trailing comma on bare tuple prohibited

title: Checks for the presence of prohibited trailing commas.
summary: Trailing commas are not essential in some cases and can therefore be viewed as unnecessary. Ruff takes this rule from flake8-commas and made it stable in v0.0.223.

title: Check that comparisons are overlapping.
summary: If you use --strict-equality, mypy will generate an error if it thinks that a comparison operation is always true or false. These are often bugs. mypy does not enable this error code by default. Use --enable-error-code comparison-overlap to enable it.
